organisations.description: State-backed body that funds Berlin's pop music scene and also acts as a contact point, adviser and broker for musicians and music businesses.
Advisory centre run by Kulturprojekte Berlin that gives artists, creatives and cultural businesses guidance on funding, financing and business questions.
Online community portal of Kulturprojekte Berlin where creatives build profiles, network and find funding calls, jobs, workshops and events.
Berlin's public venture capital arm, which takes minority stakes (typically EUR 200k–1m) in scalable early-stage Berlin companies, with creative industries as one of its focus sectors.
Berlin's state development bank, which runs most of the city's grant, loan and startup-finance programmes for SMEs, including creative businesses.

organisations.canonical_name: Projekt Zukunft – Senatsverwaltung für Wirtschaft, Energie und Betriebe
organisations.description: The Berlin economics department's initiative for the digital and creative economy, funding sector projects, design programmes and international presentations.

organisations.canonical_name: Senatsverwaltung für Kultur und Gesellschaftlichen Zusammenhalt – Kulturförderung (incl. Hauptstadtkulturfonds)
organisations.description: The Berlin culture department's funding office, which handles project, venue, stipend and studio funding for artists and administers the Hauptstadtkulturfonds.

organisations.canonical_name: Berlin Partner für Wirtschaft und Technologie GmbH
organisations.description: Berlin's business development and investment agency, which supports companies, including creative and media firms, with relocation, expansion, funding and networking services.
Berlin's chamber of commerce, with dedicated creative-industries contacts who provide sector information, networks and a first point of contact for member businesses.
Chamber of crafts that registers and advises craft businesses in Berlin, including designer-makers and applied-arts workshops.

organisations.canonical_name: Atelierbüro im kulturwerk des bbk berlin
organisations.description: Central contact point for Berlin visual artists looking for or trying to keep a studio, and the operator of the allocation process for publicly funded studios.

organisations.canonical_name: bbk berlin – Berufsverband Bildender Künstler*innen Berlin
organisations.description: Professional association of Berlin visual artists that lobbies on their behalf and offers members legal, tax and insurance advice.
Cooperative network of Berlin's music businesses that represents the sector and runs programmes such as the Music Ambassador travel grants with Musicboard.
Association of about 140 Berlin clubs, festival and event organisers that represents club culture to politics, authorities and the press.
Advice and professional-development centre for musicians and music professionals, offering free one-hour consultations, subsidised coaching, workshops and networking events.
The Berlin music council's advisory service, helping freelance musicians with career start, grants, artists' social insurance (KSK) and dealings with authorities.
Association of Berlin's independent contemporary music scene that allocates the state's project funds for new music and sound art and advocates for freelance musicians.
Federally funded body based in Berlin that funds pop and jazz artists, live venues and music companies and supports music export.
National trade association of independent labels, publishers and self-releasing artists, based in Berlin, representing their business and political interests.
LAFT Berlin programme that offers independent performing artists an information centre, advice, mentoring, qualification and an online compass to funding and venues.

organisations.canonical_name: LAFT Berlin – Landesverband freie darstellende Künste Berlin e.V.
organisations.description: State association of Berlin's independent theatre and dance scene that represents its interests and operates the Performing Arts Programm.
Information and advice office for Berlin dance artists, offering individual consultations, workshops on applications and budgeting, and peer support.
Berlin-based national umbrella association for the independent performing arts that lobbies for freelance theatre and dance makers.
State-funded company that secures, develops and lets work and presentation spaces for the independent arts scene and runs the city's Arbeitsraumprogramm.
Berlin's centre for diversity development in culture, offering consultations, anti-discrimination advice, empowerment programmes and workshops for artists and institutions.
Information portal and help desk for internationally mobile artists covering visas, taxes, social insurance and contracts, run jointly by ITI Germany, IGBK and Dachverband Tanz.
Independent design institution, founded in 1968, that links businesses with designers and promotes design as a driver of economic and social innovation.

organisations.canonical_name: Berlin Career College (UdK Berlin) – Berliner Startup Stipendium / Creative Prototyping
organisations.description: UdK Berlin's career and transfer unit, which runs the Creative Prototyping startup scholarship (EUR 2,200/month for 6 months, coworking and mentoring) for creative founders.
dffb-run meeting point for professional Berlin filmmakers with events, pitches, a coffee club and a 3–6 month mentoring programme.
Regional network of media and digital companies whose games:net initiative connects studios and publishers through events, trade-fair pavilions and delegation trips.

organisations.canonical_name: game – Verband der deutschen Games-Branche e.V.
organisations.description: Berlin-headquartered national trade association of the games industry that represents developers and publishers and supports the sector's growth.
Anchor institution for Berlin's independent literary scene that runs a public programme and projects for writers and literary initiatives.

organisations.canonical_name: Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels – Landesverband Berlin-Brandenburg
organisations.description: Regional association of publishers and booksellers that represents the book trade in Berlin and Brandenburg.
Statutory professional chamber for Berlin architects and planners that maintains the architects' register and supports members professionally.
Non-profit-run former printing-press factory in Gesundbrunnen that rents work spaces to artists, small businesses and social organisations at moderate rents.
Former BVG tram depot with about 80 artist studios plus dance and rehearsal rooms, secured since 2024 through a 20-year lease held by Kulturraum Berlin gGmbH with state rent subsidies.
Contemporary dance centre with 16 studios combining rehearsal, training and venue space, with studios rentable for artistic projects.
Artist-run studio house in a former piano factory in Alt-Treptow where more than 40 artists work, with regular open studios.
Artists' association running a shared studio building in a former dairy yard in Prenzlauer Berg/Mitte, with exhibition and event space.
Association-run studio courtyard in Kreuzberg 61 providing long-term artist studios.
Historic Wedding courtyard complex owned by Gesobau where an artists' association manages studios for more than 40 artists and hosts annual open studios.
Artist hub in northern Berlin that rents studios and runs residencies, exhibitions, workshops and an artist award.

organisations.canonical_name: ZK/U – Zentrum für Kunst und Urbanistik
organisations.description: Artist-run centre in a former railway depot in Moabit offering residency studios, project space and a neighbourhood programme on art and urbanism.
Association-run artist and craft studios on a former railway site next to S-Bahnhof Nöldnerplatz in Lichtenberg.
Studio and workshop centre for arts and crafts in a former margarine factory in the Herzbergstraße area.
Former GDR vehicle depot turned creative quarter with artist studios and workshops alongside the haubrok foundation exhibition space.
Large studio complex on a former state-security site in Hohenschönhausen with around 270 artist studios.
Association-run studio house in Zehlendorf (Schlachtensee) providing artist studios in the south-west of the city.
Studio centre in Reinickendorf's Tegel area with artist studios listed in the city's studio-house directory.
Studio floor in a former factory in Alt-Reinickendorf, part of the Berlin Arbeitsraumprogramm with GSE gGmbH as tenant.
Association-run studio house in Pankow-Heinersdorf offering artist studios.
Artists' association in Weißensee running studios and cultural space.
Studio house in Weißensee listed in the bbk kulturwerk studio-house directory.
Converted industrial building in Weißensee's industrial estate with artist studios and event space.
Studio house in Spandau's Siemensstadt, one of the few artist studio buildings in the western outer districts.
Artist courtyard with studios in Charlottenburg's historic Alt-Lietzow quarter.
Studio building in Wilmersdorf listed in the bbk kulturwerk directory of studio houses.
Association-run studio building on the Treptow canal with studios and an artist-in-residence programme.
Studios run by the Karl Hofer Gesellschaft on the former industrial riverside site in Oberschöneweide, which also hosts Atelierhaus79 and Xtro Ateliers.
Non-profit association running studios, a cinema, galleries and street-art courtyards off Hackescher Markt.

organisations.canonical_name: Bildhauerwerkstatt im kulturwerk des bbk berlin
organisations.description: Publicly funded 3,600 m² sculpture workshop in a former safe factory with areas for metal, stone, wood, ceramics, plaster, plastics and 3D scanning, bookable by professional artists for a small fee.

organisations.canonical_name: Druckwerkstatt im kulturwerk des bbk berlin
organisations.description: Subsidised print workshop at Kunstquartier Bethanien offering intaglio, relief, lithography, large-format screen printing, Risograph, digital fine-art printing and bookbinding.

organisations.canonical_name: Medienwerkstatt im kulturwerk des bbk berlin
organisations.description: Subsidised media-art workshop at Kunstquartier Bethanien with editing workstations, a greenscreen studio, an acoustically treated audio room and an 80 m² media lab.
Senate-funded production centre in a former school offering affordable rehearsal rooms for independent theatre, dance and performance.
Second Theaterhaus site in the former Ernst Busch drama school building, providing subsidised rehearsal rooms for the independent performing arts.
Musician-owned, association-run former ORWO film factory with about 100 rehearsal rooms, recording studios and a concert hall, described as Europe's largest self-managed rehearsal complex.
Music hub on the RAW site with studio-quality hourly rehearsal rooms (noisy Rooms), coworking, a stage and seminar rooms for musicians and music businesses.
Self-service 24/7 rehearsal, DJ, recording and podcast studios bookable by the hour.
Hardware makerspace and coworking hub with 3D printing, laser cutting, CNC machining, metal welding and maker garages; selected in 2025 to run a future makerspace at ringberlin in Mariendorf.
Free public library makerspace in Neu-Hohenschönhausen with sewing and embroidery machines, plotter, heat press and 3D printer.
Public library makerspace near Rosenthaler Platz with sewing and embroidery machines, cutting plotter, 3D printer, photo studio and media digitisation.
Public library makerspace in Wedding with 3D printer, embroidery and overlock machines, engraving and textile printing.

organisations.canonical_name: Haus der Statistik – Haus der Materialisierung
organisations.description: Pioneer-use building in the Haus der Statistik model project hosting material-reuse initiatives, textile and repair workshops and event spaces.
Established coworking space with desks, private offices, meeting rooms and event spaces popular with freelancers and startups.
Pioneering café-coworking space at Rosenthaler Platz with flex offices, team rooms, meeting rooms and an event space.
Cooperative riverside quarter in Friedrichshain mixing venues with small creative businesses such as a recording studio, photo studio, music school and coworking.
Former GDR broadcasting centre in Oberschöneweide with legendary recording halls, smaller studios and long-term studio and office tenants from the creative industries.
Listed former malthouse in Schöneberg/Tempelhof redeveloped since 2005 for creative-industry production spaces, offices and event venues.

Intercultural neighbourhood centre in Charlottenburg offering meetings, exercise, advice, learning and volunteering.
Neighbourhood centre sharing a building with a district library and citizens' office, supporting local engagement.
Community house by Volkspark Wilmersdorf with dozens of weekly courses plus sewing, wood and bike workshops.
Grunewald community centre run by Sozialwerk Berlin with a focus on self-help and activities for older residents.
Westend meeting place where long-time and newly arrived residents meet through culture, education and talks.
Long-established Kreuzberg neighbourhood house (since 1955) with social, cultural and advice services and a room-request service.
Reichenberger Kiez meeting point with café, book exchange and counselling that lends rooms to local and self-help groups.
Culture and neighbourhood centre in Friedrichshain's Rudolfkiez focused on community-led neighbourhood work.
Kotti neighbourhood centre with mostly free culture, education, sport and counselling, offering space for many kinds of groups.
Volkssolidarität centre with intergenerational meetups, exercise groups and education and language courses.
Multigenerational house in Kreuzberg offering neighbours and local initiatives space for self-help and engagement.
Kiezspinne's neighbourhood house in Frankfurter Allee Süd with counselling, family, arts and self-help programmes and bookable rooms.
Open neighbourhood centre in Alt-Hohenschönhausen with a meeting space, advice and courses for all ages.
Friedrichsfelde neighbourhood hub run by pad gGmbH, now based in the renovated KULTSchule, offering advice and project support.
Neu-Hohenschönhausen centre organising social and cultural activities with residents; initiatives may use rooms for regular meetings.
Welsekiez meeting place with social advice, family and creative activities and a neighbours' café; rooms available to initiatives.

organisations.canonical_name: Nachbarschafts- und Familienzentrum Kiek in (Stadtteilzentrum Marzahn-NordWest)
organisations.description: Marzahn NordWest centre offering social advice, education, culture and support for self-help and civic participation.
Kiek in-run neighbourhood meeting place on the western edge of Marzahn-Nord.
BALL e.V. neighbourhood centre in the restored horse stable at Gut Biesdorf with an event hall and seminar rooms.
Community-building centre for residents of all ages and backgrounds with a strong volunteer focus.
Inclusive Mahlsdorf meeting place with courses and events that also supports neighbourhood work and self-help.
Hellersdorf-Nord centre with workshops, cultural events, social advice and groups such as chess and language exchange.
Kaulsdorf neighbourhood centre whose rooms can be used for various non-profit purposes.
Klub 74's centre in Hellersdorf-Süd with rooms bookable for courses, seminars, meetings and celebrations.
Volkssolidarität centre on the Marzahner Promenade that also provides rooms for residents' own events.
Marzahn centre run by Wuhletal that invites residents to start their own leisure, culture or exchange groups.
AWO neighbourhood meeting house in Mahlsdorf-Süd with courses, events and free advice.
Moabiter Ratschlag's neighbourhood centre with open courses, groups, events, counselling and social support.
Intercultural neighbourhood hub in the Sprengelkiez for meetings, advice, learning, health and local engagement.
Tiergarten-Süd community centre hosting education, meetings and counselling for a diverse neighbourhood.
Brunnenviertel centre with social gatherings, advice, hobby and sports groups; rooms are available for non-commercial use.
Fischerinsel community centre supporting self-help, volunteering and low-cost leisure, with theatre, sport and music rooms on request.
Inclusive Gesundbrunnen centre offering education, fitness and creative programmes and rooms for initiatives, groups and events.
Parkviertel community centre in Wedding with open activities, courses, events and a café.
Körnerkiez neighbourhood house combining a family centre, youth and community work and a daily café.
Intercultural Reuterkiez centre open since 1984 with leisure, education and counselling for families and adults.
Schillerkiez centre connecting neighbours through events, street outreach and a free lending shop.
Internationaler Bund centre running participatory community events for a diverse neighbourhood.
Open Buckow centre with advice, exchange, sport and play and space for volunteering and self-organisation.
Gropiusstadt meeting place supporting neighbourly ties, local initiatives and volunteering.
New (2025) Rudow centre with a shared house and garden, bringing generations together, starting with a repair café.
Intercultural centre with fitness, advice, language courses, self-help groups and a café, renting out seminar and group rooms.
Französisch Buchholz community centre (temporary site during Amtshaus renovation) with courses, advice, culture and room rental.
Pfefferwerk centre near Teutoburger Platz with advice, exhibitions, workshops and rooms for groups and events.
Mühlenkiez neighbourhood centre connecting residents through inclusive arts and culture since 2018.
Weißensee neighbourhood work fostering local initiative, mutual help and integration and countering loneliness.
Albatros multigenerational house hosting several neighbourhood projects, festivals and workshops.
Neighbourhood meeting point offering counselling for families, women and people in crisis and work with refugees.
Reinickendorf-Ost centre with meeting spaces, multilingual counselling and intercultural groups and courses.
Interim Lettekiez neighbourhood meeting point that self-help and neighbourhood groups can use while a new building is planned.
New Borsigwalde meeting place with café, senior activities, homework help and cultural events.
Märkisches Viertel centre for all ages with language help, form assistance and creative activities.
Märkisches Viertel centre with advice, education and cultural activities that also rents out rooms.
Waidmannslust neighbourhood centre offering advice and cultural, creative and educational activities.
Albatros neighbourhood shop in Tegel hosting community activities and social gatherings.
casa e.V. centre with social advice, groups, courses, workshops and cultural events in Siemensstadt.
Heerstraße Nord meeting place supporting residents' projects, adult activities and local volunteer networks.
Staaken shop-front neighbourhood centre helping residents meet and run projects.
Gatow neighbourhood house where residents meet and get support for their own initiatives.
DRK-run Kladow centre offering counselling, referrals and volunteering support across many local topics.
Intergenerational, intercultural centre in Spandau-Neustadt with advice, groups and courses and a room-rental service.
Haselhorst meeting point fostering intergenerational and intercultural exchange and neighbourly help.
Interim Falkenhagener Feld neighbourhood base preparing a future centre in the former Zufluchtskirche.
Zehlendorf villa with neighbourhood café, counselling, self-help and volunteering connecting generations.
Historic manor house serving as an intergenerational neighbourhood centre, with rooms also rented out.
Steglitz neighbourhood house run with a parish, with several rooms, kitchen and garden for events and courses.
Lichterfelde-Süd meeting place for mutual help, family activities and a language café.
Lankwitz site of the joint SüdOst neighbourhood centre, offering a local meeting place.
Lichterfelde site of the SüdOst centre run by Mittelhof e.V. as a neighbourhood meeting house.
Open Friedenau neighbourhood house with courses, culture and family support that hosts many self-help groups.

organisations.canonical_name: Nachbarschafts- und Selbsthilfezentrum in der ufaFabrik (NUSZ)
organisations.description: Tempelhof neighbourhood and self-help centre at the ufaFabrik with group, dance and dojo rooms for courses and workshops.
Centre opened in 2025 with language cafés, family groups, digital help for seniors and health activities.
Schöneberg neighbourhood shop with community activities, self-help groups and social and cultural programmes.
Lichtenrade neighbourhood centre with community, health, democracy and culture programmes and a weekly café.
Cooperative Lichtenrade-Marienfelde centre helping residents organise and voice local interests (second site at Lichtenrader Damm 198-212).
Accessible Köpenick community house with courses, advice and self-help groups, welcoming new interest groups.
Schöneweide villa for intergenerational meetings, neighbourhood initiatives and creative projects.
Centre for Spindlersfeld and Köllnische Vorstadt with meetings, courses, advice and homework help.
Volunteer-driven Alt-Treptow centre with theatre, gallery, courses and environmental projects; rooms are rented out.
Altglienicke family centre housing integration advice, a daycare and family support programmes.
Allende-Viertel meeting space with a community room for up to 15 people, available by arrangement.
Main Wedding site of the district adult education centre, one of three VHS Mitte core buildings.
District adult education centre's Kreuzberg learning and service centre.
Main building and postal address of the Pankow adult education centre.
Main site of the Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf adult education centre, in a rear courtyard.
Spandau's adult education centre in the heart of the old town.
Main location of the district adult education centre in the former Lichterfelde town hall.
Main building of the Tempelhof-Schöneberg adult education centre.
Neukölln's adult education centre, sharing its building with the district music school.
Main building of the Treptow-Köpenick adult education centre in Baumschulenweg.
Main building of the Marzahn-Hellersdorf adult education centre.
Lichtenberg's adult education centre, co-located with the district music school.
Reinickendorf's adult education centre at the Borsigturm, with registration on the third floor.
Public music school of Mitte; head office at the Rathaus Tiergarten complex.
Public district music school headquartered in the Bethanien building.
Pankow's public music school, with branches across the district.
Public music school of Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf.
Spandau's public music school in the old town.
Public music school of Steglitz-Zehlendorf.
Tempelhof-Schöneberg's public music school, housed with Haus am Kleistpark.
Neukölln's public music school.
Public music school of Treptow-Köpenick in Köpenick's old town.
Public music school of Marzahn-Hellersdorf.
Lichtenberg's public music school.
Reinickendorf's public music school in Tegel.
District youth art school in Wedding offering workshops with professional artists.
Youth art school in a Kreuzberg backyard by U-Möckernbrücke (entrance also Obentrautstraße 56).
Pankow's district youth art school for children and teenagers.
District youth art school in Charlottenburg-Nord running courses and school workshops.
Spandau's youth art school based in the Zitadelle since 1996.
District-run youth school for art and media education on the Albert Schweitzer campus.
District youth art school in Schöneberg with term and holiday programmes.
Main site of Neukölln's youth art school, which also runs branches in Gropiusstadt, Dammweg and Körnerpark.
District youth art school in a courtyard building in Köpenick.
Marzahn-Hellersdorf's youth art school, the main user of the renovated Kulturforum Hellersdorf.
Youth art school in Hohenschönhausen with afternoon and holiday courses.
Berlin's first youth art school, in the Märkisches Viertel, with its own gallery.

organisations.description: District gallery for contemporary art in Wedding.
Communal gallery of Mitte in Moabit.
District exhibition space in Mitte's gallery quarter.
Former bear pit in Köllnischer Park converted into a district art venue.
Ruined Franciscan monastery church used by the district for art and events.
District contemporary art space in the Bethanien arts quarter.
Communal gallery in one of the towers at Frankfurter Tor.
District project space in a former fire station in Friedrichshain.
Communal gallery of Pankow.
District gallery in Prenzlauer Berg, reopened in September 2026 after renovation.
District-run cultural centre in the Ernst-Thälmann-Park (temporarily at Schönfließer Straße 7 during renovation).
District theatre for independent productions (temporarily at Schönfließer Straße 7 during renovation).
Cultural centre with stage, cinema and gallery, listed among Pankow's own cultural institutions.
District open-air stage by the Weißer See.
Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf's municipal gallery, run by the district culture office.
Communal exhibition space of Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf near Breitscheidplatz.
District cultural centre with gallery, cinema, theatre hall and studio stage.

organisations.description: District centre for contemporary art inside the Spandau Citadel.
Medieval town house in Spandau used by the district for exhibitions.
Communal gallery in a historic cellar in Spandau's old town.
District cultural centre and gallery in a 19th-century villa in Steglitz.
Historic manor house used by the district for exhibitions and events.
Tempelhof-Schöneberg's municipal gallery with an adjoining project room.
Communal gallery in the Tempelhof district museum in Mariendorf.
Neukölln's communal gallery in the historic Saalbau.
Communal gallery in the orangery of Körnerpark.
Largest cultural centre in southern Neukölln, with stage programme and gallery.

organisations.description: District cultural centre with municipal gallery and art lending.
Communal gallery in the former Johannisthal town hall.
Socio-cultural centre run by the district culture department, with music, theatre and courses.
District-run palace housing a municipal gallery for art and public space.
District exhibition centre run by the Fachbereich Kultur in Hellersdorf.
Large cultural and leisure centre operated by GSE on behalf of the district.
Project space for contemporary art listed among the district's culture venues.
Communal contemporary art gallery in the Ratskeller of Lichtenberg town hall.
Interdisciplinary district gallery in a Hohenschönhausen high-rise.
Communal gallery and art lending service in Alt-Hohenschönhausen.
District cultural centre with concerts, theatre and a gallery.
District-run modernist house showing contemporary art and architecture.
Communal gallery in Reinickendorf town hall.
Communal gallery floor in the district museum in Hermsdorf.
District event venue with halls for concerts, theatre and community events.
